## ObsidiAI 0.1.10

### Updated model catalog

- Update the bundled pi AI and Agent runtime from `0.85.1` to exact-pinned `1.2.0`, including its current provider model catalogs.
- Add newly cataloged OpenAI models including **GPT-6 Luna**, **GPT-6 Sol**, and **GPT-6.1 Sol**, including their OpenAI Codex entries. Anthropic's catalog now includes **Claude Haiku 5.5**, **Claude Sonnet 5.5**, and **Claude Opus 5.5**. Visibility and access still depend on your connected provider and account.
- Clarify that **Refresh models** updates dynamic providers only. Static built-in catalogs are bundled into the plugin and require a plugin update and reload.

### Runtime compatibility

- Adapt prompt updates to pi's transcript-owned system messages, preserving current session permissions when changing models or reopening chats.
- Keep sent attachment previews working in both existing chats and newly saved history after the runtime upgrade.
- Declare the YAML parser used by the test host explicitly instead of relying on a transitive runtime dependency.

### Install or update

1. Download **[obsidiai-0.1.10.zip](https://github.com/KNN-07/ObsidiAI/releases/download/0.1.10/obsidiai-0.1.10.zip)**, not GitHub's automatic source archive.
2. Replace `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` in `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/obsidiai/`. Preserve `data.json` and `history.json` if present.
3. Reload Obsidian or disable/re-enable ObsidiAI after the current run settles, then open the composer model picker.

Requirements remain **Obsidian desktop 1.11.4+** and **embedded Node 22.19.0+**. The three individual plugin files are also attached.

### Verification

- Production build and strict typechecking, all **169 tests**, release metadata/assets validation, and generated-bundle syntax checks passed locally on Node 24.
- An isolated CommonJS runtime built with the production bundler configuration loaded the refreshed catalogs and confirmed that the new OpenAI and Anthropic models are selectable with configured test credentials, without network requests or host-fetch mutation.
- Real-Agent behavioral checks cover approval after reopening a chat, permission changes, conversation continuation, legacy attachment-reference migration, repeated history reloads, and new attachment submission.
- Native Obsidian model-picker behavior and remote inference/account access for the newly cataloged models have not been verified.
